**Alder 3 Burr Coffee Grinder**

Great coffee starts with a consistent grind, and the Alder 3 delivers it every morning. Its hardened steel conical burr cuts beans evenly rather than crushing them, so you get balanced extraction and cleaner flavor whether you're brewing espresso, pour-over, or French press.

With 40 precise grind settings, you can dial in everything from fine Turkish powder to coarse cold-brew grounds, and make small adjustments as your beans or recipe change. The 250-gram hopper holds enough for several days of brewing, so you can fill it once and skip the daily measuring.

The Alder 3 runs quietly, feels solid on the counter, and takes apart easily for cleaning. Its compact design fits comfortably in small kitchens without sacrificing performance.

Backed by a 2-year warranty, the Alder 3 is built for years of daily use.

**Just $219.**

Upgrade your routine. Taste the difference the Alder 3 makes in every cup.
